name: price-range
title: Price range
description: A price for products with variants: 'From 19', '19 to 39' or one price, with sale ranges handled and struck through.
docs: min and max are minor units. variant="from" shows the lowest price after a word; variant="range" shows both ends with Intl formatRange. cents="auto" drops .00 when every figure is whole. The compare-at range is struck through only when it is higher.
